## CertifiedDeviceHTTP

Explicit fixed loopback /rpc?v=1&client_id endpoint through borrowed HTTP transport. One in-flight prioritized complete-array replacement, 200 + exact nonce/command/null acknowledgement, bounded bodies and awaited cancellation cleanup. Empty arrays clear device state; no scans, background hardware observers, proxy/redirect authority, automatic mutation replay or certified-hardware qualification. Verified and locally added 2026-10-17. RPC v1 and JSON are independent from REST/Gateway v10. Current source fingerprints: Docs/Parity/rpc-device-current-sources.json; original discovery provenance is preserved. ## OpusMediaFraming

Owned RFC6716 ordinary framing/entropy/pulse codebooks now compose with bounded CELT low-overlap MDCT/IMDCT, single-band pulse search/spreading/normalization and SILK LPC/LTP/excitation reconstruction primitives. Independent libopus1.6.1 component fixtures and seeded verification do not establish a complete audio codec. Portable PCM queues/clocks/pacing/resampling and synthetic-only speech VAD remain implemented. ApplePlatform adds explicit macOS input/output UIDs, iOS/tvOS/visionOS preferred inputs and bounded device metadata/route cleanup; watchOS input and non-macOS output selection are explicitly unsupported by these APIs. Native device runtime and Windows/Android adapters remain unqualified or unimplemented. Full SILK/CELT/hybrid compressed syntax, energy/allocation/splitting/stereo/mode transitions, encoder analysis, PLC/FEC and official decoded-PCM conformance remain absent. Video labels are metadata only. Added2026-10-17; continuation and full12A gates: Docs/Parity/changes/2026-10-17-phase12a-codec-routing.md.
